etymology: a primitive root, apparently meaning to mediate in religious services
avSummary: priest's office 20, decketh 1, office of a priest 1, priest 1
definition:
1) to act as a priest, minister in a priest's office
    1a) (Piel)
        1a1) to minister as a priest, serve as a priest
        1a2) to be or become a priest
        1a3) to play the priest
